payload.title: bug: agy-herdr dispatch (executeExecutorCli via herdr-spawn, provider agy) returns…
payload.description:
bug: agy-herdr dispatch (executeExecutorCli via herdr-spawn, provider agy) returns outcome:unsignaled with headBefore==headAfter after capturing only the pane's startup banner, never actually running the worker's task

Reproduced 2x in a row (2026-08-26, driving tsk-2tr via /fgOS:cook): node src/runner/dispatch.mjs execute fgos-coding-implement --prompt-file <real prompt> --has-live-task-access resolved to executor=fgos-coding-implement via=herdr-spawn provider=agy model=gemini-3.6-flash-medium. Both times the returned stdout was just the Antigravity CLI startup banner (version/email/model/cwd ASCII art) plus a bare shell-prompt echo -- never any real task output, headBefore==headAfter (no commit), outcome:unsignaled. Switching the same prompt to executor=claude (cli-spawn) worked and produced real, correct implementation work in the same call.

Likely a completion-detection timing bug in the herdr-spawn adapter for agy specifically -- it appears to read the pane's initial idle-shell state as 'done' before the agy process has actually started/finished its task, rather than waiting for a real completion signal. Given tsk-2tr's own recent commits (e29f05f2, 42de168f) just redesigned agy-herdr's interactive-mode visibility/exit-code handling, this may be a regression or an incomplete fix in that area -- worth checking against real evidence, not assumed.

Verify: reproduce via node src/runner/dispatch.mjs execute <an agy-herdr-backed executorId> --prompt-file <a real prompt> --cwd <a real worktree> --has-live-task-access against real herdr/agy binaries and confirm headAfter reflects a real commit, not headBefore==headAfter with a banner-only stdout.
